user.title: Set up MindClip
user.description: Connect one SwitchBot AI MindClip. Credentials are stored in the Home Assistant config entry and are never exposed by entities or diagnostics.

data_description.api_token: Open Token from SwitchBot Developer Options.
data_description.api_secret: Secret Key paired with the Open Token.

select_device.title: Choose a MindClip
select_device.description: Multiple AI MindClip devices are available to this SwitchBot account.

manual_device.title: Enter the MindClip device ID
manual_device.description: No AI MindClip was returned by device discovery. Enter its SwitchBot device ID manually.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate MindClip
reauth_confirm.description: SwitchBot rejected the saved credentials. Enter a valid API token and API secret for this MindClip.

data_description.api_token: Replacement Open Token from SwitchBot Developer Options.
data_description.api_secret: Replacement Secret Key paired with the Open Token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MindClip
reconfigure.description: Validate and update this MindClip configuration. The device ID must continue to identify the same physical device.

data_description.api_token: Open Token from SwitchBot Developer Options.
data_description.api_secret: Secret Key paired with the Open Token.
data_description.device_id: The existing SwitchBot device ID for this AI MindClip.

error.invalid_auth: SwitchBot rejected the API token or secret.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to SwitchBot. Try again later.
error.invalid_device: SwitchBot could not find an accessible AI MindClip with this device ID.
error.api_error: SwitchBot rejected the request. Verify the device ID and try again.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The device ID does not match this config entry. Add it as a separate MindClip instead.

init.title: Optional Calendar sync
init.description: Create Calendar events for newly discovered MindClip To-Dos that have reminders. Leave Calendar empty to disable synchronization.

data_description.calendar_entity: A writable Home Assistant Calendar entity.
data_description.event_duration_minutes: Duration of each created event in minutes.

error.calendar_not_writable: Select a Calendar that supports creating events.

list_recordings.name: List recent recordings
list_recordings.description: Returns bounded metadata for the most recent MindClip recordings. No transcript or summary content is included.

config_entry_id.name: MindClip
config_entry_id.description: The configured MindClip whose recordings should be listed.

limit.name: Maximum recordings
limit.description: Number of recent recordings to return, from 1 through 50.

get_recording.name: Get recording details
get_recording.description: Returns metadata for one MindClip recording. The response is not stored in an entity, but may appear in automation traces.

config_entry_id.name: MindClip
config_entry_id.description: The configured MindClip that owns the recording.

recording_id.name: Recording ID
recording_id.description: The SwitchBot recording ID to retrieve.

get_transcript.name: Get recording transcript
get_transcript.description: Returns the full private transcript and speaker list for one recording. The response is not stored in an entity, but may appear in automation traces.

config_entry_id.name: MindClip
config_entry_id.description: The configured MindClip that owns the recording.

recording_id.name: Recording ID
recording_id.description: The SwitchBot recording ID to retrieve.

get_summary.name: Get full recording summary
get_summary.description: Returns the full private transcript, AI results, To-Dos, and speakers for one recording. The response is not stored in an entity, but may appear in automation traces.

config_entry_id.name: MindClip
config_entry_id.description: The configured MindClip that owns the recording.

recording_id.name: Recording ID
recording_id.description: The SwitchBot recording ID to retrieve.

action_invalid_auth.message: SwitchBot rejected the saved MindClip credentials.

action_rate_limited.message: SwitchBot rate-limited the MindClip request. Try again later.

action_cannot_connect.message: Unable to connect to SwitchBot for this MindClip request.

action_invalid_response.message: SwitchBot returned invalid or unavailable MindClip data.
